findings.current: The first was the Family Head of the Zhuge Clan, arguably the wealthiest family in Hubei.
findings.defect: The Korean describes the Zhuge Clan’s Family Head as arguably Hubei’s wealthiest person, not the clan as the wealthiest family. This changes the subject of the wealth claim.
findings.rationale: The phrase “호북 제일의 거부” characterizes the person as Hubei’s wealthiest; it does not say that the Zhuge Clan is Hubei’s wealthiest family.
findings.replacement: The first was the Family Head of the Zhuge Clan, arguably the wealthiest man in Hubei.

summary: The assembled translation is faithful overall, with one minor change to who is described as Hubei’s wealthiest.
